Paragraph: "And here I stand, a prince of Ayodhya, wandering helpless while my wife remains in the hands of evil..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Stark realization of his current state—a prince reduced to wandering in exile while his wife is held captive.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama confronts his current loss of status and role struggle.
Outcome/Resolution: He expresses severe sorrow regarding his temporary helplessness.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Dainya (State of feeling humbled, helpless, and divested of external power)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The Divine experiences extreme vulnerability (Dainya) to demonstrate patience and righteous action under adverse human conditions.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Identity and role crisis: feeling helpless and disempowered when comparing past royal status with present loss.
